name: Omarchy Friends
author: Omarchy Friends Contributors
description: Ambient presence and serendipitous peer connections for Omarchy users: share quiet vibes, toss sparks to the campfire, and map your constellation of encounters.

barWidget.description: Ambient campfire presence, anonymous vibe sharing, and peer sparks across the Omarchy universe.

schema.label: Share Country
schema.description: Include your country flag with sparks. When disabled, signals appear as 'The Cosmos'.

schema.label: Play Chime on Spark
schema.description: Play a gentle notification chime when a peer tosses a spark to you.

schema.label: Default Vibe
schema.description: Initial ambient vibe: focus, flow, coffee, midnight, shipping, zen.
